header: Directly querying Amazon S3 data in OpenSearch Service
content:
This section will walk you through the process of creating and conﬁguring a data source integration
in Amazon OpenSearch Service, enabling you to eﬃciently query and analyze your data stored in
Amazon S3.
Available AWS Regions for Security Lake
739
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
In the following pages, you'll learn how to set up an Amazon S3 direct-query data source, navigate
the necessary prerequisites, and follow step-by-step procedures using both the AWS Management
Console and the OpenSearch Service API. It also covers important next steps, including mapping
AWS Glue Data Catalog roles and conﬁguring access controls in OpenSearch Dashboards.
